title: Prediction market events
description: Search by phrase, by venue, or both. With neither, the actor returns the most traded open events across all 12 venues.

search.title: Search phrase
search.description: Words to look for in event titles and descriptions, such as "fed decision" or "world cup". Leave empty to list the most traded events.

venue.title: Venue
venue.description: Only events from this venue. Leave empty for all 12.

maxEvents.title: Maximum events
maxEvents.description: How many events to return, most traded in the last 24 hours first.

outcomesPerEvent.title: Outcomes per event
outcomesPerEvent.description: How many of each event's outcomes to include with their prices: outcomes traded in the last 24 hours first, then by probability. 0 keeps only the leading outcome and makes one request in total instead of one per event.

includeClosed.title: Include closed events
includeClosed.description: Also return events that stopped trading in the last 10 days.
